exposure: 12-step initiative targeting organisational structures, healthcare personnel, and the birthing population
cohort: A national sample of 67,649 term births (21,232 at the index hospital and 46,417 at two control hospitals) in Denmark from 2003 to 2017.
finding: A multi-component initiative significantly reduced the cesarean section rate at the index hospital by an extra 0.75% annually compared to control hospitals, decreasing from 21.1% to 12.0% over 9 years.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate at the index hospital decreased significantly, and there was no significant change in instrumental birth rates.
